sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Bb]There is afountain filled [Eb]with blood
[Bb]Drawn from Emmanuel's veins;
[Bb]And sinners plunged beneath that flood
[Bb/D]Loseall [Eb]their guilty [Bb]stains.
[Bb]Lose all their guiltystains,
[Bb]Lose all their guiltystains;
[Bb]And [Eb]sinners plunged beneath [Bb]that flood
[Bb]Loseall their guilty [F7]stains.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Bb]The dying thief rejoiced to see that fountain [Eb]in his [Bb]day;
[Bb]And there may I, [F]though vile [Bb]as he, wash all my sins away.
[Bb]Wash all my sins away, wash all my sins [F7]away;
[Bb]And there may I, though vile as he, wash [F7]all my sins away.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Bb]Thou dying Lamb, Thy precious blood shall never [Eb]lose its power
[Bb]Till all the ransomed [F]church [Bb]of God are saved, to sin no more.
[Bb]Are saved, to sin no more, are saved, to sin [F7]no more;
[Bb]Till all the ransomed church of God are saved, [F7]to sin no more.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [Bb]E'er since, by faith, I saw the stream Thy flowing [Eb]wounds supply,
[Bb]Redeeming love [F]has been [Bb]my theme, and shall be till I die.
[Bb]And shall be till I die, and shall be till [F7]I die;
[Bb]Redeeming love has been my theme, and shall [F7]be till I die.

sections.name: Verse 5
lines: [Bb]Lord, I believe Thou hast prepared, unworthy [Eb]though I [Bb]be,
[Bb]For me a blood-bought [F]free [Bb]reward, a golden harp for me!
[Bb]A golden harp for me! A golden harp [F7]for me!
[Bb]For me a blood-bought free reward, a golden [F7]harp for me!

sections.name: Verse 6
lines: [Bb]There in a nobler, sweeter song, I'll sing [Eb]Thy power to [Bb]save,
[Bb]When this poor lisping, [F]stammering [Bb]tongue is ransomed from the the grave.
[Bb]Is ransomed from the grave, is ransomed from [F7]the grace;
[Bb]When this poor lisping, stammering tongue is ransomed [F7]from the the grave.
